verify.note: Runs scripts/load-soak.mjs --smoke --json and imports the real slos.ts through scripts/probe-ts.mjs: the report must say it judged against lib/observability/slos.ts and carry the three SLO rows at the targets slos.ts states; each of the five hot paths must have been driven (requests, numeric p95 and error rate, verdict pass) and judged against its own SLO row; the run must have been against the local mock; and the harness module must refuse frequencylocal.com and a build reporting build.env production without --allow-production (pure functions, no request). Fails on main: the harness does not exist. Exits 79 only when the smoke child cannot be spawned or is killed. Sends nothing off the machine.

append.detail:
── UNPARKED AND CLOSED 2026-09-29 (owner ruling 2026-09-29 ~18:00Z: "pull it into this cycle now"; ADR-1621). The ruling replaces the number gate (1,000 profiles or a hot-path 28-day p95 over its SLO) as the reason to build, and it is newer than the 03:45Z "keep gated" ruling and the ADR-1573 park, so ownerAction waiting and parkedUntil 2027-01-05 are removed. PREMISE RE-TESTED FIRST (ADR-1082) on main at d332f1335: package.json carries no k6, artillery or autocannon; nothing under scripts/ or test/ puts load on anything; scripts/perf-baseline.mjs samples one request at a time and, for People directory, times /people, which is a redirect into /network (ADR-172). Still true, so built.

WHAT SHIPPED. scripts/load-soak.mjs, plain node, no new dependency (fetch, node:http and the probe-ts resolver the repo already has). It drives the five OBSERVABILITY-BASELINES 2 hot paths (GET /feed, /circles/<slug>, /network, /events, and the practice-log write as a POST carrying the build's Next-Action id) as an open-model arrival rate with drops counted at the concurrency cap, in three profiles (steady, spike = base then 10x then base, soak), records p50/p95/p99, max, status classes and the error rate per path per phase, judges each path against latency.read-hot-paths or latency.practice-log-write and error-rate.requests read from the shipped lib/observability/slos.ts (never re-typed), and writes a JSON report (--out; real runs default to a git-ignored load-soak-<profile>-<stamp>.json) carrying target, build.env, commit, the SLO rows read, and the --data-volume and --region the operator states. Verdicts are pass, breach, unmeasured (a login bounce is not the page) and skipped (a missing input, named); the run is incomplete rather than pass when any path did not measure. --smoke is the CI-safe self-test: an in-process mock on 127.0.0.1, every path including the write, the real SLO table, exit 1 unless complete and passing (it caught a real bug in the harness while it was being written). scripts/load-soak.test.ts covers the locks, profiles, the SLO read, the verdicts and the mock end to end.

SAFETY, because a preview shares production's database (docs/WORKFLOW.md): no default target and no CI job that loads a deployment; production refused twice, by host (frequencylocal.com and subdomains, plus LOAD_SOAK_PRODUCTION_HOSTS) before any request and by build.env at /api/status (production, or a remote target that cannot answer), both lifted only by --allow-production; a 100 rps ceiling no flag lifts; the write path off unless --writes with a session and the action id; the two secrets (LOAD_SOAK_COOKIE, VERCEL_AUTOMATION_BYPASS_SECRET) read from env and never printed or reported. How to run it: OBSERVABILITY-BASELINES 2d and 5, and a pointer from RUNBOOKS section 4.

NOT HERE, stated so the close is not read as a measurement: no run against any deployment was made (the owner ruling asked for the harness, and the rule is never load production; a preview is production's database). OBSERVABILITY-BASELINES 2b stays empty under its own gate, and the reading this row originally asked to be pasted there arrives from a real run once that gate opens. The H3 items beyond the harness (RLS claim caching, index fill, partitioning, read replicas, CDN) are still filed one at a time from what the harness shows. DEF-HARDEN stays open on OWN-082, the owner's.
